component.name: ExoImperium: Space Tycoon (Demo)
component.summary: Deep-space planetary mining empire and tactical sci-fi tycoon

description.p: ExoImperium: Space Tycoon is an isometric sci-fi strategy and management game where you expand an interstellar mining corporation across procedurally generated planetary systems.

Extract valuable resources such as Ferro, Copper, Gold, and Eterium. Refine synthetic materials, manage planetary energy grids, construct orbital trade routes, and command defensive battle fleets against rival alien factions.

ul.li: Self-contained 4-planet sector campaign showcasing core economic and tactical progression.
Industrial base construction: Extractors, Nuclear Reactors, Warehouses, and Circuit Factories.
Automated inter-planetary trade stations and freight logistics.
Tier 1 scientific research tree and shipyard light combat fleet management (Scouts and Fighters).
Optimized for desktop Linux and SteamOS / Steam Deck with 60 FPS performance and trackpad controls.

screenshot.caption: Colony overview with industrial mining extractors and logistics hub
Galactic star map navigation and inter-planetary trade routes
Imperial technology tree and scientific research branches
Imperial shipyard fleet production and tactical defense management

description.p: Initial evaluation demo release for Linux desktop and Steam Deck.

ul.li: Optimized Skia 2D rendering pipeline at 60 FPS.
